mechanics.claim: Unburrow deals magic damage to nearby enemies and knocks them up on cast (self-centered burst, not a targeted ability).
mechanics.quote: emerging from the ground to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knock them up}} for 1 second

mechanics.claim: Rek'Sai can be knocked out of Burrowed into Unburrowed by attacking, casting the ability automatically once in range and applying the damage/knockup to the attack target.
mechanics.quote: Rek'Sai can also trigger Unburrow by issuing an attack command, casting the ability once she is in attack range of the target and applying the knock up against them.

mechanics.claim: Targets already hit by Unburrow cannot be displaced by it again for a duration, but presumably can still be damaged; this affects repeat-cast damage application on the same target.
mechanics.quote: Targets hit cannot be displaced by Unburrow again for some time.

mechanics.claim: Unburrow does not count as an ability activation for on-cast effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: Unburrow does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse (Kassadin) passive.

mechanics.claim: Burrow (W as a burrowed-state toggle) does not itself deal damage and has no cast time; its cooldown starts after casting Unburrow.
Unburrow's own cooldown begins only after the target is displaced (knocked up/back), not on cast.
mechanics.quote: Begins after the target is displaced

mechanics.claim: While burrowed, Rek'Sai gains bonus movement speed, which does not affect either fight (no allies/terrain to path around, and speed doesn't change damage dealt or taken).
